newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to make cellular announcement.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to make cellular announcement.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said it has scheduled a telephone media briefing on Wednesday at 1100 EST, during which it will announce developments in the division.

Motorola said the briefing is to "announce significant developments in the cellular PCS (personal communications services) marketplace". A company spokesman declined to give further details, citing its customer's plans to announce the deal before the briefing. He withheld the name of the customer.

Industry analysts speculated the company will announce a contract with a Japanese wireless phone company for code division multiple access (CDMA) technology, which can be used with PCS. CDMA, a digital technology, increases the number of calls a wireless phone network can handle and enhances call quality.
"The Japanese were evaluating CDMA technology, so we knew there was some work there," said John Lazlo, an analyst for PaineWebber. "It's a huge win for Motorola."
